content: Nimizai ɠa kɔɔɠɔ gani kɔɔ nuɓusɛiti bɛ

content.text: Telebo nuiti undaa ɠa ʋilisu
kɛlɛ nu nɔpɛ ge la yiizoolɛzu ga tiye,
nu ʋagɔiti ti ɗa ɲɛɛlɛ,
nu nɔpɛ ge la ɠidaazu bu
ga telebo nuiti ta loozu bu,
nimizai é ʋaazu, naa ʋoola ti ʋa.
Kɛlɛ ziilɛigi ɠa ʋaazu,
zɔiti ti ziɛzu ga pele zɔlegi,
naati zoo niina ti ɲi ziilɛigi zu.
«Kɛlɛ wa ʋe de, à ʋaa lɛɛ ʋɛ, ungaiziɛ anzanui ná-dointi,
wɛɛnziɛ nui, koloɠolo anzanui ma zuwuzuiti!
Ɓɛ ɠa wo ɲɛɛɠulazu su?
Ɓɛ ɠa wo laalaosu ɓawuu daalɔɠɔma,
wo ɗa wo-nɛgiti kula?
É la ga gaama, ɓaa, ga wa ga kololala lointi,
yaava zuwuzuiti,
wɔiti wo ɠaazosu ga wo yiima vaiti daazeelilalai sɛne guluiti bu,
ta gulu wolai ɠilagilagiti pɛ,
wɔi wo doungoiti kulazu ga zalaɠai,
wo ɗa ti ɠɔdaaleʋe pɛtugiti su, kɔtu yeɠeiti su.
Kɔtu maaloungaiti ti pɛtugi zu, è ʋoluzeigiti kana,
toɠa ná è-ʋogi ɠa ná!
Naati ka è dɔɔ zalaɠai ʋuuzu ti ma,
è ɗa vebɛaniiti kɛ ná ga gala zalaɠai,
zìi ɠaalɛi naazu ɓaa?
È è-laazuʋɛ ɓɛtɛʋɛ gize ɠaaɠoozagiti maazu.
Mináti ka è lɛɛzu ná, è ɗa zalaɠaiti kula.
È ɗa-zalei lɔɔɠuʋɛ kpogi ʋoluʋɛ.
Ɗa è maaɲakai ɠulazu pòluʋelei dɔɔɠuzu,
è lɛ ɗa-ʋetei zu, è è-laazuʋɛ zuwɔɔlɔ,
è è-nɛɛɲɔɠɔiti geyani,
nɛɛʋɛ è ʋɛ ga è ɗa la ti ɠoba,
è ti ɠabei ɠaani.
È lobɛanii leʋeni galagi Mɔlɔke ʋɔ,
ga gulɔ ɲadegai ta gulɔ maku nɛɛnɛgi,
è ɗa-ɠeelaiti teʋeni ɠoozama,
naa maaʋele ma, è ɓɔɠɔ looni bu,
eyɛsu è yei gɔvɛalaazu.
È ɠaaɓaa ga è ziɛ ɠana,
è gaaɓela ga è ɓɔɠɔ ɓɔlɔ.
Kɛlɛ è la ɠɛɛni ma:
‹Gè mina yɛ wafuun fai tɛi polu.›
È zɛbɛ niinɛi zɔlɔɔni ʋolu,
è ɓudɛ ɗa-ɓɔlɔi maazu.
Ɓɛ ɠa é ɠɛni è yiizoolɛzu,
ɓɛ ɠa è ɠɛni luazu ba, ga è yaava,
ga è mina ɠisiɛzu sù,
è ʋa yiizoolɛ ga nà-faa?
Suɠooza gè la faa nɔpɛ bosu,
tanisu naa ʋe, é kɛa è la unfesu mà.
Nà ʋaazu kulazu kɛlɛma ga è la ga sɔbalala nu ʋelei è ɠisiɛzu la,
ta gè è-zɔgiti kula kɛlɛma.
È la kulanuma nɔpɛ sɔlɔɔga.
Ɗa kpee loona, è wooɠula ti ma,
ɗa-yɛɛ ɠalagiti ti è ɠulana faa zu!
Fiilɛi li ga ti pɛ, fiilɛ goi ti pɛ zɛʋɛ!
Kɛlɛ niiti pɛ ta lɔɔɠuzu ɠaiziɛ pɔ̀ bɛ,
ta zooi zɔlɔɔ ga tɔnɔ,
ta nà-gize ɲadegai zɔlɔɔ ga tɔnɔ.»
Toɠa ɠɛ ma:
«À pelei ɓɛtɛ, à pelei ɓɛtɛ,
à pelei laalao,
à kaka fai pɛ zeɠe pelei zu nà-nuɓusɛiti tuɠɔ!»
Mazɔlɔɔ GALA é geezuʋɛ Anii-Pɛ-Unga,
é ná ɠɔoɠɔ, daaseigi ga Ɲadegai, tɔ ɠa é nii wosu:
«Nà zeini ada ɠaaɠooza golai, ná ɲadegai,
kɛlɛ nà naama nuiti ba, ti ti zopele ɲɔuzu,
ta ɓɔɠɔmaayei zɛnvui ti-yiimaʋɛ,
nii a kɛ gè zɛnvui ve ɓɔɠɔmaayei nuiti bɛ,
nii a kɛ gè zɛnvui ve naama nuiti bɛ ti ti zopele ɲɔuzu.
Gè la yɛsu kpɔɛi laawu yeenɔpɛ,
ɓaa gè ʋa ziiɠaawanai makɛ eyɛsu ɠɔ.
Ni naa laade, nii kpein gè kpɛtɛai,
ti-yɛnvui zɛbɛi maa ɠa lɔi.
Izilayɛle nuɓusɛi ná-ani wɔin ɲɔi zìiɠaawanani.
Gè doɠani, gè lɔɔɠu ba ga ziiɠaawanai,
kɛlɛ kololala nui ʋilɛni nɔ ziima ʋelei ʋolu.
Gè ná-kɛɛwotii ɠwɛɛ, kɛlɛ nà kɛdɛsu,
gè lo tuɠɔ, nà ziilaazu gola,
ta niiti ti yiizoolɛai tɔun bɛ.
Nà maamusɛ wuyei lɔ ti-la.
Ziilɛigi, ziilɛigi ɠa naa ʋɛ é ɠoozama
ta zɔi maaɓuɠaai,»
Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI wooi ɠana.
«Ungo, nà nà-nuɓusɛiti kɛdɛsu.»
Nu ɲɔiti kɛɛʋɛ eɠɛ kpoloɗɛi é ɲiikpisu,
é la zooga é ʋa la kpɛ,
ma ɗɛiti ti ɗa nɔɠɔi ma zii pɛ buzeɠe.
Nà-GALAGI ɠɛ:
«Ziilɛi ge la faa ɲɔu ɠɛ nuiti bɛ pɛ!»
